title: Wiri north quarry orthophotograph, 1982
credit: Land Information New Zealand (LINZ), via Retrolens and Wikimedia Commons.
altText: 1982 aerial orthophotograph showing Wiri railway station and the north quarry in Auckland.
caption: Aerial orthophotograph of Wiri railway station and quarry, 7 February 1982.
context: LINZ orthophotograph sourced from Retrolens. It provides a later example of corrected aerial imagery and illustrates the chapter’s discussion of orthophotography; it does not depict the earlier 1977 Clutha–Alexandra production work.
sourceFileTitle: File:Wiri north quarry 1982.jpg (3840 × 3745 Wikimedia Commons rendition)
derivativesNote: The locally archived JPEG is the 3840 × 3745 Wikimedia Commons rendition. The 6760 × 6593 full-resolution master is linked above. This JPEG is stored unchanged; WebP display and card variants were resized without cropping.
